title: Frequently Asked Questions
intro: Answers below are drawn only from publicly stated information on the Kitchen & Flooring Depot source site. Where the source does not publish a detail, we say so.

items.question: How can I request an estimate?
items.answer: Call (860) 757-3330, email hr@kitchenflooringdepot.com, visit the showroom, or use the quote form on this website. The source site offers a free in-store estimate.

items.question: What services do you offer?
items.answer: Kitchen remodeling, cabinets, flooring (including tile, hardwood, laminate and vinyl), countertops, and bathroom vanities.

items.question: Do you install what you sell?
items.answer: Yes. The kitchen remodeling page states that Kitchen & Flooring Depot can install products from flooring to countertops, sinks, and faucets.

items.question: What are your exact opening hours?
items.answer: The source site states “We are open 7 Days a Week” but does not publish exact daily open/close times. Please call to confirm before visiting.

items.question: Do you publish product prices online?
items.answer: No. The public source site does not list SKUs, stock counts, or checkout pricing. Request a quote for current pricing.
